answer.report_md: 本页只有一个编号图 FIG.2.10，但由两种形态拼合：上方四个手绘剖面线饼图（1969/1979/2000/2015，各6个扇区，标签以引出箭头置于圆外，如“EI 30.7%”“S 38.8%”），下方一个双纵轴折线图（左“Overall GDP (10⁹ DA 1979)”、右“Per capita GDP (10³ DA 1979)”），实线与点划线区分两条序列，序列名直接写在线旁，并有带箭头的区段年均增长率批注“(7.97 %)”“(4.85 %)”及脚注“(1)”。生成器需能画：无图例的多面板异构图、饼图外置引线标签、双轴、点划线、区段跨度箭头注记。取值困难在于：饼图数值只靠两字母代码（A/MI/C/E/EI/S）+ 顶部年份定位，12.5% 在 1979 的 MI 与 2000 的 EI 中重复出现，必须年份+代码联合寻址；折线无数值标注，200 只是左轴刻度。不确定：图例说明行（A: Agriculture…）应算标题续行还是脚注；x 轴 1979→1985 间隔为6年却等距。

heading.title: Energy and nuclear power planning study for Algeria:  past and future trends in overall and per capita GDP and distribution by sector (in Algerian dinars (DA)).
heading.subtitle: A: Agriculture.  MI: Manufacturing industries.  C: Construction. E: Energy.  EI: Extractive industries.  S: Services (including transport).

four same-format sector pies titled 1969, 1979, 2000, 2015 in a row
'EI 30.7%', 'S 38.8%' etc. set outside each pie on leader arrows
'Overall GDP (1)' superscript with note '(1) Average annual growth rate of overall GDP compared to 1979 (in brackets).'
'Overall GDP' and 'GDP per capita' written beside their lines, no legend
GDP per capita drawn dash-dot, Overall GDP solid
'Overall GDP (10\u2079 DA 1979)' and 'Per capita GDP (10\u00b3 DA 1979)' set vertically
axis titles carry '(10\u2079 DA 1979)' and '(10\u00b3 DA 1979)'; ticks are bare 0-700
note line '(1) Average annual growth rate...' and series names drawn inside the frame
x ticks 1969, 1974, 1979, 1985, 1990 ... equally spaced though intervals differ
filled dot and open diamond point markers overlaid on the two lines
